name: Serverless REST API
description: HTTP API (API Gateway v2) in front of a Node.js Lambda that creates, lists and reads items in a DynamoDB table through the AWS SDK.

name: Queue worker
description: SQS queue with a dead-letter queue and a Lambda consumer that processes messages in batches and reports partial failures.

name: Event fan-out
description: SNS topic, encrypted with its own KMS key, that fans every message out to two SQS queues (billing and shipping) with least-privilege queue policies.

name: Static website
description: S3 bucket configured for static website hosting with a public-read policy, an index page and an error page.

name: Scheduled job
description: EventBridge Scheduler invoking a Lambda function on a rate expression through a dedicated scheduler role.

name: VPC basics
description: VPC with two public subnets in different availability zones, an internet gateway, a public route table and a web security group.

name: Step Functions workflow
description: Step Functions state machine that invokes a Lambda task, waits, and branches on the result.

name: Pub/Sub and Cloud Storage
description: Pub/Sub topic with a pull subscription and dead-letter topic, plus a Cloud Storage bucket for message archives.

name: Storage account with queue
description: Resource group with a storage account, a private blob container and a storage queue.

name: Object Storage bucket
description: OCI Object Storage bucket in a compartment, with the namespace looked up automatically.

name: Reverse proxy (NGINX on EC2)
description: An NGINX server in a public subnet accepts every client request and forwards / to a web server and /api/ to an API server, both in a private subnet the internet never sees. Runs locally: Floci starts the three instances and the proxy answers on a published port.

name: API gateway (HTTP API + Lambda authorizer)
description: One HTTP API is the single entry for two services: a Lambda authorizer checks the bearer token on every call, then /orders goes to the orders function and /users to the users function. Runs locally: Floci enforces the authorizer and invokes both functions.

name: Load balancer (ALB)
description: An Application Load Balancer gives an Auto Scaling group of two app servers one public address, sends requests only to servers that pass its health check and answers /admin/* itself with a 403 rule. Runs locally, but the listener port is only reachable inside the sandbox network.

name: Reverse proxy (Front Door)
description: Azure Front Door is the one public endpoint and forwards / to a web App Service and /api/* to an API App Service, which accept traffic only from this Front Door profile. Design and export only: Floci does not emulate Front Door or App Service.

name: API gateway (API Management)
description: API Management is the single entry for two App Service backends: callers need a subscription key, and /orders and /users are routed to their own backend. Design and export only: Floci does not run the API Management gateway.

name: Load balancer (Standard LB + scale set)
description: A Standard Load Balancer gives a two-instance VM scale set one public IP and sends traffic only to instances that pass its HTTP health probe. Design and export only: Floci does not emulate Azure Load Balancer or scale sets.

name: Reverse proxy (HTTPS load balancer + Cloud Run)
description: A global external HTTPS load balancer is the one public address and its URL map sends / to a web Cloud Run service and /api/* to an API Cloud Run service, which accept traffic only from the load balancer. Design and export only: Floci runs Cloud Run but not the load balancer.

name: API gateway (Apigee)
description: Apigee is the single entry for two Cloud Run services: its proxy verifies the caller's API key, then routes /orders and /users to their own service with a Google-signed identity token. Design and export only: Floci does not emulate Apigee.

name: Load balancer (managed instance group)
description: A global external Application Load Balancer gives a two-VM managed instance group one public IP, sends requests only to VMs that pass its health check and recreates VMs that keep failing it. Design and export only: Floci does not emulate load balancers or instance groups.

name: Reverse proxy (Load Balancer path routes)
description: A public OCI Load Balancer is the one entry and its path route set sends / to a web server and /api/ to an API server, both in a private subnet. Design and export only: Floci does not emulate OCI load balancers or compute.

name: API gateway (API Gateway + Functions)
description: An OCI API Gateway deployment is the single entry for two Functions: an authorizer function checks every request's token, then /orders and /users go to their own function. Design and export only: Floci does not emulate API Gateway, and its Functions API (20181201) is not the one oracle/oci 9.3 and newer call, so the functions don't deploy locally with the provider release Nimbo targets either.

name: Load balancer (flexible LB)
description: A flexible OCI Load Balancer gives two instances one public IP, spreads requests round robin and sends traffic only to instances its health checker reports OK. Design and export only: Floci does not emulate OCI load balancers or compute.
